question: Under what condition does that one remain free from even slight agitation caused by them?
premises: A group of feminine entities is referenced.
The condition is not going to agitation even slightly.
inference: The condition described is when that one does not undergo even the slightest agitation from them.
uncertainties: The identity of tāsām and asau is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: When that one does not go to even the slightest agitation because of them.
